title: Fix wrong log message
description:
Fix wrong log message
    
Britney2's Hint object has no 'days' attribute, so we ought not try to print it.
    
Seen in the wild for several hours during the Artful Alpha 1 milestone freeze, when a duplicate block hint caused britney to fail to run due to the resulting exception.
diff:
diff --git a/britney.py b/britney.py
index de20218..847aecc 100755
--- a/britney.py
+++ b/britney.py
@@ -1077,9 +1077,9 @@ class Britney(object):
                                (x, package, hint.version, hint.user, hint2.version, hint2.user), type="W")
                             hint.set_active(False)
                     else:
-                        self.log("Overriding %s[%s] = ('%s', '%s', '%s') with ('%s', '%s', '%s')" %
-                           (x, package, hint2.version, hint2.user, hint2.days,
-                            hint.version, hint.user, hint.days), type="W")
+                        self.log("Overriding %s[%s] = ('%s', '%s') with ('%s', '%s')" %
+                           (x, package, hint2.version, hint2.user,
+                            hint.version, hint.user), type="W")
                         hint2.set_active(False)
 
                 z[package] = key
